Bolt length: L = factor × excavation span B, where the factor grows with the rock class (I 0.20, II 0.25, III 0.30, IV 0.35, V 0.40, VI 0.45) and is at least 2.0 m, with the result to one decimal place.
map.锚杆间距：S=min(L/2, 级别上限)——Ⅰ~Ⅱ级上限 1.5 m、Ⅲ级 1: Bolt spacing: S = min(L/2, class cap) — 1.5 m for classes I–II, 1.2 m for class III, and 1.0 m for class IV and above, laid out in a quincunx pattern; the worse the rock, the tighter the spacing.
map.厚度按级别取 5/8/12/18/22/25 cm（Ⅰ~Ⅵ级）；每延米锚杆数量=: thickness by grade is 5/8/12/18/22/25 cm (grades I–VI); the number of bolts per metre = ceil(support perimeter ÷ S²), where the support perimeter is approximated as 2 × (B + H), and multiplying by L gives the total bolt length per metre; support recommendations are given by grade as combinations (grades I–II local bolts + thin shotcrete, grades III–IV systematic bolts + mesh + shotcrete, grades V–VI systematic bolts + double mesh + steel-fibre shotcrete plus steel arches where needed).

map.这是工程类比法的经验取值，用于初选参数与工程量估算，不能替代设计验算。锚杆长度需: This is an empirical value from engineering analogy, meant for first-pass parameter selection and quantity estimates and no substitute for design verification. Bolt length must keep the anchorage zone deep enough into stable rock (generally at least 0.5–1.0 m) and satisfy the suspension or composite arch theory checks; shallow burial, unbalanced pressure, fault zones, and swelling rock require dedicated calculation by the design institute, with longer bolts or anchor cables if needed.
map.每延米锚杆数量为什么按 ceil(周长÷间距²) 计算？: Why is the number of bolts per metre computed as ceil(perimeter ÷ spacing²)?
map.工具把支护面近似为按 S×S 网格布点的展开面，用周长 2×(B+H) 作单延米: The tool approximates the support surface as an unfolded plane with bolts laid out on an S × S grid, using the perimeter 2 × (B + H) as the unfolded width per metre, so bolts per metre = ceil(perimeter ÷ S²), rounded up so no position is missed. This is a simplified estimate: with an actual staggered layout adjacent rows are offset by half a grid, so the count differs slightly, and the spacing at the arch and the sidewalls may also be set separately, so quantity checks should follow the construction drawings.

map.每延米锚杆数量为什么按: Why are bolts per metre calculated as ceil(developed length ÷ spacing²)?
map.工具把支护面近似为: The tool approximates the support surface as a developed plane with an S×S grid. The developed length for the selected shape/range is the one-metre developed width, so bolts per metre = ceil(developed length ÷ S²), rounded up to avoid gaps. The default roof + side walls uses B+2H and excludes the floor; an arched section uses arch + straight walls, and full perimeter with floor is only an upper-bound estimate. In a staggered layout adjacent rows are offset by half a spacing and crown/wall spacing may differ; use construction drawings for quantities.
